description: Shell script for testing CRLF (Carriage Return Line Feed) conversion and line ending normalization in a Git repository. Contains functions for creating gitattributes, comparing files, and performing various tests on line ending conversions under different configurations.

methods.name: compare_files
methods.description: Compares two files after normalizing line endings and removes temporary files.

methods.name: compare_ws_file
methods.description: Compares two files with special transformations for whitespace and binary characters.

methods.name: create_gitattributes
methods.description: Creates a .gitattributes file with specified attributes for line ending normalization.

methods.name: check_warning
methods.description: Checks for expected warning messages related to line ending conversions.

methods.name: commit_check_warn
methods.description: Performs a commit with specific attributes and checks for warnings.

methods.name: commit_chk_wrnNNO
methods.description: Sets up and commits files with various line endings and attributes, checking warnings.

methods.name: commit_MIX_chkwrn
methods.description: Commits files with mixed line endings and checks for warnings.

methods.name: stats_ascii
methods.description: Returns a string representing the line ending type for display.

methods.name: attr_ascii
methods.description: Generates a string representing git ls-files --eol attribute output based on parameters.

methods.name: check_files_in_repo
methods.description: Compares files in the repository against expected line ending files.

methods.name: check_in_repo_NNO
methods.description: Checks files in the repository with non-normalized line endings.

methods.name: checkout_files
methods.description: Sets up checkout configurations, performs checkouts, and verifies line endings and attributes.
